4336.title: Failed user-bus probe bypasses persistent installation
4336.rootCauseOneLine: A failed user-bus probe sets the skip-service option internally, causing success before persistent unit creation.
4336.proposedFix: Separate explicit service-free mode from failed systemd setup; recover current-user bus access or fail clearly.
4336.caveats: Extracted shell branch reproduced twice; no live enrollment, actual systemd operation, or reboot test.
